summary: Jacob loves and favors Joseph, who is hated by his brothers—Joseph dreams that his parents and brothers make obeisance to him—His brothers sell him into Egypt.
meta_description: Jacob loves and favors Joseph, who is hated by his brothers—Joseph dreams that his parents and brothers make obeisance to him—His brothers sell him into Egypt.

footnotes.note3_c: The Septuagint word indicates many colors, but the Hebrew term may indicate simply a long coat with sleeves.
footnotes.note36_c: HEB eunuch (which often designates a royal official).
footnotes.note36_d: HEB chief of the butchers, or the cooks; probably the chief steward.
